benefit_text: The scheme gives financial assistance of ₹ 1,20,000 per unit for plain areas and ₹ 1,30,000 per unit for hilly, difficult areas and IAP districts. A beneficiary can get a loan of up to ₹ 70,000 at 3% lower interest and a subsidy on a principal of up to ₹ 2,00,000. It also gives up to ₹ 12,000 for toilet construction, a LPG connection, and employment as a rural mason at ₹ 90.95 per day for 95 days.
who_can_apply: Households without any shelter, living on alms, manual scavengers, primitive tribal groups and legally released bonded laborers are included. The scheme also targets families living in zero, one or two room kutcha houses. Eligibility does not depend on age or income.
documents: Aadhaar number and self‑attested copy of the Aadhaar card, Job Card registered with MGNREGA, Bank account details, Swachh Bharat Mission number, and an affidavit stating the family does not own a pucca house.
how_to_apply: Visit the official PMAY‑G website and log in. Fill personal details, upload the Aadhaar consent form and search for your name. Register by selecting ‘Select to Register’, then add bank details, loan choice, MGNREGA job card number and SBM number as prompted.
